radiationStorm.title: Solar storm
radiationStorm.alert: Forecast: a radiation storm may be coming. Get the shelter ready.
radiationStorm.impact: Radiation storm! Everyone to the water shelter.
cascade.energy.entered: Out of power! Emergency mode: only air, no science and less heating. The crew feels the cold.
cascade.lifeSupport.entered: Air or water is running out! Emergency mode: everyone breathes and drinks less and gets tired faster.
cascade.food.entered: The food ran out! Emergency mode: smallest rations for everyone.
cascade.health.entered: {name} can't go on and is resting in the sick bay.
cascade.overdue: The margin is over: the emergency gets worse.
cascade.noReturn.allResting: The whole crew is resting. Mission paused: they are safe in the shelter waiting for rescue.
cascade.noReturn.twoMeters: Two systems have been empty for too long. Mission paused: the crew is safe in the shelter waiting for rescue.
sacrifice.cleanPanels.title: Go outside to clean the panels
sacrifice.cleanPanels.cost: Whoever goes out gets radiation and gets tired.
sacrifice.moxieOff.title: Turn off MOXIE
sacrifice.unpowerShelter.title: Unplug the shelter
sacrifice.unpowerShelter.cost: The shelter protects less in a storm.
sacrifice.drinkWaterShield.title: Drink the shield water
sacrifice.drinkWaterShield.cost: The shelter has no water: much more radiation in the next storm.
sacrifice.boostRecycler.title: Give the recycler more power
sacrifice.boostMoxie.title: Give MOXIE more power
sacrifice.medicCare.title: Let Senda care for the sick one
sacrifice.medicCare.cost: Senda stops her task and the others get more tired.
sacrifice.reduceRoutines.title: Do fewer tasks
sacrifice.extraRations.title: Give extra food to the sick one
sacrifice.prioritizeGreenhouse.title: Put the greenhouse first
radiationStorm.explanation.deepSpace: In space there is no air or magnetic field to stop particles from the Sun. BioSentinel, a spacecraft carrying living yeast, measured this storm.
radiationStorm.explanation.mars: The air on Mars is very thin and barely stops particles from the Sun. The Curiosity rover measured this storm from Gale crater.
radiationStorm.response.goToShelter.cost: Tasks stop and nobody goes outside until it passes.
radiationStorm.response.keepWorking.cost: The crew gets much more radiation.
dustStorm.title: Dust storm
dustStorm.alert: The sky is turning brown: a dust storm may be coming.
dustStorm.impact: Dust storm! The panels barely get any light. Share out the power.
dustStorm.explanation: Curiosity's light sensor could barely see the Sun: dust covers the sky. In 2018 a storm like this shut down the Opportunity rover.
dustStorm.response.heatFirst.title: Heating first
dustStorm.response.airFirst.title: Air first
dustStorm.response.airFirst.cost: The base gets colder and no science gets done.
dustStorm.response.scienceFirst.title: Keep doing science
scrubberFailure.title: Broken scrubber
scrubberFailure.alert: The air scrubber is making strange noises.
scrubberFailure.impact: The scrubber broke! CO2 is going to rise.
scrubberFailure.explanation: The scrubber removes the CO2 we breathe out. If it builds up, it causes headaches and tiredness.
scrubberFailure.response.repair.title: Fix it with a spare part
scrubberFailure.response.repair.cost: Uses a spare part and a few hours of work. Miga does it faster.
scrubberFailure.response.improvise.title: Fix it without a spare
scrubberFailure.response.improvise.cost: Takes many more hours and tires the crew.
micrometeoroid.title: Micrometeoroid
micrometeoroid.impact: A tiny space rock made a hole: air is leaking.
micrometeoroid.explanation: Tiny grains of rock fly through space faster than a bullet. Spacecraft have shields, but sometimes one gets through.
micrometeoroid.response.patchLeak.title: Find the leak and patch it
micrometeoroid.response.patchLeak.cost: Uses a spare part and some work. Air leaks in the meantime.
micrometeoroid.response.sealModule.title: Close that module
micrometeoroid.response.sealModule.cost: That module's air is lost and the ship gets smaller.
isolation.title: Isolation
isolation.impact: Nobody has talked to Earth for many days. Spirits are dropping.
isolation.explanation: In the Mars-500 experiment, six people lived shut in for 520 days. Talking to home helped a lot.
isolation.response.callHome.title: Call home
isolation.response.callHome.cost: The radio uses power and the answer takes a while to arrive.
extremeNight.title: Extreme night
extremeNight.alert: Forecast: tonight will be extremely cold.
extremeNight.impact: Freezing night! The heating can barely keep up.
extremeNight.explanation: Curiosity really measured this temperature in Gale crater. The air on Mars is so thin that heat escapes right away.
extremeNight.response.heatMore.title: More heating
extremeNight.response.closeZone.title: Shut down part of the base
extremeNight.response.closeZone.cost: The greenhouse goes dark and cold.
highCo2.title: High CO2
highCo2.impact: There's too much CO2! Everyone has a headache.
highCo2.explanation: NASA says CO2 should stay below 3 mmHg. Above that come headaches and tiredness.
highCo2.response.repairScrubber.title: Fix the scrubber
highCo2.response.repairScrubber.cost: Uses a spare part and a few hours of work.
highCo2.response.reassignEnergy.title: Give the scrubber more power
greenhousePest.title: Greenhouse pests
greenhousePest.alert: The plant leaves have little spots.
greenhousePest.impact: Pests in the greenhouse! The plants are getting sick.
greenhousePest.explanation: NASA scientists study how plants grow far from Earth. Looking after them often keeps pests away.
greenhousePest.response.botanistCare.tit: Let Brote care for the plants
greenhousePest.response.botanistCare.cos: Brote stops his task for a few hours.
greenhousePest.response.pullPlants.title: Pull out the sick plants
sealDust.title: Dust in the seals
sealDust.alert: The airlock doesn't close well: there's dust in the seals.
sealDust.impact: A little air is leaking through the airlock.
sealDust.explanation: Mars dust is super fine and gets everywhere. The airlock has to be cleaned after every trip outside.
sealDust.response.pauseEva.title: Don't go outside for now
sealDust.response.pauseEva.cost: No samples are collected and air keeps leaking.
solarConjunction.title: Solar conjunction
solarConjunction.alert: In a few days the Sun will be between Mars and Earth.
solarConjunction.impact: The Sun blocks the signal: no Mission Control. Only saved messages are left.
solarConjunction.explanation: Every two years the Sun gets between Earth and Mars. NASA stops sending commands to its robots for about two weeks.
solarConjunction.response.decideAlone.co: No advice or remote help until it passes.
radiationStorm.explanation: Solar storms throw out particles that go through the walls of the ship.
realEvent.uvLow: Sunlight "low" on sol {sol} ({sols} sols in a row)
realEvent.conjunctionDays: {days} days without sending commands to Mars
